title: Meal Planning & Grocery Cross-Feed Daily Correlation
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=pantry:inventory) OR (index=personal sourcetype=mealime:plan)
| bin _time span=1d
| eval feed=case(sourcetype="pantry:inventory","primary",sourcetype="mealime:plan","secondary",1=1,"other")
| stats count as events by _time feed
| chart sum(events) over _time by feed
description: Lines up daily volume from pantry:inventory and mealime:plan to see whether two meal planning feeds move together.
value: When two related exports diverge — one busy, one silent — it usually means a connector broke on only one path.
implementation: Forward both `pantry:inventory` and `mealime:plan` into `index=personal` and compare daily counts on one chart.
visualization: Dual-line chart of daily events per sourcetype.
grandmaExplanation: It shows whether your two main meal planning data feeds rise and fall together or if one of them quietly stopped keeping up.
